proposed_sector.name: Engineering & Semiconductor
proposed_sector.blurb: Fabs, aerospace, power and heavy construction. The only field on this board where almost every seat is inside the Phoenix metro, because the work cannot be done from anywhere else.
proposed_sector.typical: Electrical, mechanical, industrial, chemical, civil and materials first, with computer science, construction management and supply chain close behind.
proposed_sector.quizResult: Your answers point at engineering and semiconductor. You want the thing you build to either work or not work, you would rather be measured against a spec than an opinion, and standing on a factory floor in coveralls to find out why a number moved sounds like a good day. Phoenix is the right city for that right now. Intel, TSMC, onsemi, Microchip and Amkor all sit inside a thirty minute drive of Tempe, and unlike the rest of this board, you will not have to leave the state to get the seat.
steps: Apply in September and October for the summer after next. Every employer here runs a fall calendar and the Summer 2027 requisitions are already open.
Settle the citizenship question before you spend an evening applying. Aerospace and defense gate most roles on US person status under export control, and that is law, not preference.
Work the Fulton career fair, not the job board. Amkor, Intel, Freeport and APS all send recruiters to campus, and a face beats a resume sitting in a queue of four thousand.

notes_for_integration: TWELVE employers, THIRTY-SEVEN roles, every URL fetched personally with a browser User-Agent and confirmed 200 with a sensible title, or rendered in Playwright where the board is a JavaScript app. Disciplines covered: semiconductor and manufacturing (Intel, TSMC, onsemi, Microchip, Amkor), electrical (all twelve), mechanical (Honeywell, Boeing, SRP, APS, Freeport, Gore), industrial (Amkor, Honeywell, Intel, Gore), civil and construction (TSMC facilities, Kiewit, APS, Freeport, Boeing facilities), chemical (Intel, TSMC, APS, Freeport, Gore), materials and metallurgical (Intel, SRP, Amkor, Gore), mining and geological (Freeport), nuclear (APS Palo Verde), biomedical (Gore Medical Products, the only real route on the board), computer science (Intel, Microchip, Honeywell cyber, Boeing analytics, Gore IT). Fifteen of the thirty-seven roles are explicitly open to non-engineering majors and are marked in the disciplines field. THREE EMPLOYERS ALREADY EXIST IN data.js UNDER OTHER SECTORS and need a decision before you paste: Intel is listed under tech with two sales and supply chain roles, Honeywell is listed under finance with the University Relations program, and Freeport-McMoRan is listed under accounting. The card renderer groups by employer, so adding a second Intel entry would draw two Intel cards. The cleanest fix is probably to let an employer carry roles in more than one sector, or to move Intel and Honeywell wholesale into engineering and leave their business roles as rows inside the same card. Do not paste blind. VERIFIED BUT CUT FOR SPACE, all 200, use if you want more than twelve: Sundt Construction, Tempe headquartered and employee-owned, https://www.sundt.com/careers/internships/ title "Internships - Construction Company & General Contractor | Sundt", page states 83 percent of senior interns convert to full time and that interns become ESOP eligible after six months and 1,000 hours. Northrop Grumman Chandler, https://www.northropgrumman.com/careers/internships-at-northrop-grumman and https://jobs.northropgrumman.com/careers?query=2027+Intern, 25 live 2027 intern requisitions nationally but ZERO in Arizona as of today, so its Chandler seats post later than the California and Utah ones. REJECTED AND WHY: Nikola is gone, www.nikolamotor.com/careers now redirects to hyroadenergy.com and 404s. Axon Scottsdale has 50 openings on its Greenhouse board and not one is an internship. Benchmark Electronics is Tempe headquartered but career.bench.com would not resolve on repeated attempts, so I would not publish a link to it. Raytheon and RTX were left out on geography, careers.rtx.com returns 200 but Raytheon is Tucson, roughly two hours each way, and the student subpaths I tried all 404. General Dynamics Mission Systems, Carvana, Lucid, Vantage Data Centers, ADOT, DPR and Banner Health were all checked and either 404, blocked curl, or had no student pipeline worth a row. FRAGILE LINKS TO WATCH: the three Intel links are individual Workday requisitions and will expire after this cycle, and their URL path says US-Oregon-Hillsboro because Phoenix is a secondary location on the requisition, which looks wrong at a glance but is correct. The durable fallback is the careersUrl. intel.com, microchip.com, onsemi.com, srpnet.com, tsmc.com and carvana.com all return 403 to curl regardless of User-Agent, so anyone re-verifying these needs a real browser. onsemi and Honeywell both sit on Oracle boards where a keyword of intern matches Internal Auditor, which is why both links use Summer Intern and Summer 2027 Intern instead.
